sourceContract: Cursor agent hook `postToolUse` reporting `duration` in milliseconds and `tool_output` as a JSON-encoded string, per cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks
author: otel-hook cursor provider owner (agent)
sanitization: Real key set, synthetic values. The duration is an invented small measurement and the tool output is an invented JSON string.
licenseBasis: Original authorship; only the field names and their types are taken from the published reference and the cited capture set.
notes: `duration` is milliseconds. The reference states so, and the CLI capture in colinsurprenant/director hack/canary/cursor-cli/findings settles it independently: a `printenv` shell call reports duration 169.812, which is 170ms and not 170s. This fixture drives DIVERGENCE-008, because the pinned Python reference multiplies Cursor's `duration` by 1000.
